title: Trump Keynotes First-Ever Republican Midterm Convention in Dallas
detail: The Republican Party opened its first-ever midterm convention at the American Airlines Center in Dallas, Texas, on Wednesday, September 9, 2026, with President Trump delivering the opening-night keynote and Vice President Vance also headlining; Trump is scheduled to return for the closing address September 10. The RNC billed the two-night event — with segments on tax cuts, healthcare affordability, the border, trade, and domestic manufacturing — as a 'primetime showcase' of Trump's record and midterm candidates, with over 100 GOP officials attending. Coverage noted the unusual format comes as Trump's approval hovers in the high-30s and several vulnerable House Republicans skipped the gathering, raising questions about whether it will meaningfully boost midterm turnout.

media.caption: Republicans opened their first-ever midterm convention in Dallas with Trump headlining opening night

title: Justice Kavanaugh Rejects Bid to Reinstate Trump-Backed Missouri Congressional Map
detail: Supreme Court Justice Brett Kavanaugh on Tuesday, September 9, 2026, declined a request from Missouri Republicans to reinstate the Trump-backed congressional map that would have dismantled Democratic Rep. Emanuel Cleaver's Kansas City-based 5th District, leaving the state's 2020-drawn map in place for November. Kavanaugh did not refer the case to the full Court or explain his order. The Missouri Supreme Court had unanimously ruled September 3 that a voter referendum petition against the new GOP map — backed by over 300,000 signatures — was 'legal, sufficient, and timely' and must go to the ballot before the map can take effect; Missouri Attorney General Catherine Hanaway called that ruling a 'constitutional crisis' and vowed to appeal. Complicating matters, a separate federal judge had ordered Missouri to use the newer GOP map anyway, arguing a post-primary switch would confuse voters — leaving the state's district lines in an unresolved conflict between state and federal courts just eight weeks before the midterms.

media.caption: Missouri's congressional map dispute reached the Supreme Court after the state's high court blocked the Trump-backed districts
